notes: BMIT's official 2019 announcement describes a new purpose-built Zejtun data centre, already under construction, with more than 400 racks and Tier 3 certification planned. Malta Properties describes Zejtun Exchange in Bulebel Industrial Estate as a GO technical hub with data-centre/offices for BMIT. Data Center Map lists BMIT Zejtun as an operational Tier III colocation facility at Bulebel Industrial Estate, Triq Hal Tarxien. No public MW capacity found.
